children.value: > Fact From Story: Now, the 2023 Nobel Prize in chemistry honors three scientists who discovered and created quantum dots.
> > Fact From Story: The second winner is chemist Louis Brus.
> > > > > Fact From Story: Brus, a professor emeritus at Columbia, said he didn’t pick up the phone when the early morning call came from the Swedish academy to notify him. | Fact From Story
> > > > > Fact From Story: Brus said he was glad to see recognition for the area of chemistry he practices. | Fact From Story
> > > > > Commonsense Knowledge: It is an honor to receive recognition for your work. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Fact From Story: One of those scientists is Moungi Bawendi.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Discoveries that change technology or medicine are important.
> Commonsense Knowledge: The Nobel Prize is a prestigious award given to people who have contributed greatly in their field.
